name: Waymantale Adventure
summary:
The very first Waymantale RPG game that started everything. The game will recieve a MAJOR overhaul once Waymantale Adventure 2: The Adult Chronicles is finished.

The Story: Jacob and his friends must stop TTG Robin from summoning Poopzilla. In order to do so, Jacob must find the six human souls. However, a new face joins the villains that could become the biggest obstacle to our heroes' victory.
